intent.proves: No product image lacks alt text.
intent.scope: image assets (file extension jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, avif or svg) of active products in scope; complete SQL enumeration

bindings.reason: get_product_images reads one product at a time; no complete host enumeration of details.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailType = 0 AND (LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpg' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpeg' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.png' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.gif' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.webp' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.avif' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.svg') AND ISNULL(d.DetailsName, N'') = N'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductId = d.DetailProductId AND p.ProductActive = 1{inScope})
